description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。最大值为100。

默认值：

- 当不设置值或设置的值小于10时，默认值为10。

- 当设置的值大于100时，默认值为100。
description.en:
Number of items per page in paginated queries. The maximum value is 100.

Default value:

- If no value is set or the set value is less than 10, the default is 10.

- If the set value is greater than 100, the default is 100.

description.zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证（Token）。
description.en: The query token returned by this call (Token).

description.zh: 资源所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region to which the resource belongs. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.
The tagKey for filtering the query.

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

查询用户云盘和快照的标签键值，可通过filterTagKey缩小查询范围。
descriptions.en:
## Interface Description
Query the tag key-value pairs of user's cloud disk and snapshot. The search scope can be narrowed down by using filterTagKey.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs describe-user-tag-keys --next-token f07b150eadfa1d7a --max-results 10 --tag-filter-key tagKey --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ebs DescribeUserTagKeys --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken f07b150eadfa1d7a --MaxResults 10 --TagFilterKey tagKey --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
